top_signals.title: MSCI Weighs Indonesia Downgrade, Removal From Global Indexes
top_signals.summary: Indonesia faces a potential ejection from global stock indexes after MSCI Inc. said the country no longer merits emerging-market status, escalating the threat of foreign investor flight as concerns deepen over market integrity.
